meta.name: Aafat 2019
meta.description: Aafat is the story about five women who happen to be the ideal suit for an arranged marriage and are in a bid to become the “Perfect Bride”. The story starts with a young boy named Ricky Malhotra who is a mamma’s boy out in search for his “perfect bride”. Watch Aafat online to enjoy this quirky tale which breaks the stereotypes and prejudices of society. The prospect brides for the marriage are, Ayesha, a girl who has never shaved herself, Anu, who works at an MNC but is bald, Faiza, who has no control over her language,  Aditi, who is an MBA but is a bit overweight, and Titli, who is an entrepreneur who has gone through a divorce. Who would become the perfect bride ultimately?

videos.title: Defected
videos.overview: Rita Mohany, a marriage bureau matchmaker, recommends five girls (Ayesha, Aditi, Faiza, Anu and Titli) to Mrs. Malhotra and her son Ricky. Unknown to them, each of the girls is just slightly defected.

videos.title: Log Kya Kahenge
videos.overview: Faiza's viral poem gets her into trouble with her father. While Anu gets serious with her boyfriend, Titli realizes her best friend has feelings for her. Meanwhile, Ayesha gets a lesson in evolution.

videos.title: Sani-Tea
videos.overview: Aditi wants to lose weight quickly for Ricky . Titli's family pressurize her about her marriage, while Ayesha's brother-in-law questions her non-waxing ways. Faiza meets an aspiring poet.

videos.title: Science of Signs
videos.overview: Anu wants her boyfriend to make a move. Aditi is torn between her new job and Ricky. Faiza has a massive fight with her colleagues. Ayesha gets schooled about how beauty is pre-conditioned.

videos.title: Express Samjhauta
videos.overview: Anu shops with a colleague who likes her. Titli's friend confesses to her parents that he likes her. Ayesha wears a bikini to a pool party. Faiza begs her father to let her do poetry. Aditi quits her job.

videos.title: The Interview
videos.overview: The Malhotras meet the families of all the five girls during the course of a week and Ricky finally chooses the future Mrs. Ricky Malhotra.
